author: reek
body: A when on a Boolean scrutinee must take the arm whose literal pattern matches it. Until this was fixed it always took the else arm, for every one of the three shapes below, because a literal pattern keeps its source spelling and the backends read "True" as a decimal number. The if forms and the integer pattern are the controls: they were correct throughout, so a run where they disagree with the Boolean rows is measuring something other than this defect.
